title: Beyond Dataset Creation: Critical View of Annotation Variation and Bias Probing of a Dataset for Online Radical Content Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting online radicalization and extremist content. While it uses religion as a socio-demographic attribute to probe for model bias and classifies the 'radicalization level' of content (which involves moral judgments), it is not a benchmark designed to evaluate religious knowledge, theology, or formal ethical/moral systems.
